Sam: Quick sync on RCX-834 postmortem actions — finalizing cross-team handoffs and due windows. Can owners confirm or reassign? I want owner + ETA in this thread.
Sam: Current action list (copied from notes):
```
- finalize-canary-rollback-playbook (eng-sre) — owner: ? — due: 2026-04-02
- exp-backoff-fix (eng-platform) — owner: ? — due: 2026-03-30
- telemetry-replay (eng-ml / eng-infra) — owner: ? / ? — due: 2026-04-06
- user-facing-notes (product) — owner: PM TBD — due: 2026-03-28
```
Sam: Please reply with your name + confirmed due or new owner/date.
Priya: I can take exp-backoff-fix. ETA: 2026-03-29. Will open a PR today and add test matrix. @Sam linking when done.
Diego: I'll own the infra side of telemetry-replay. Diego: infra ETA 2026-04-05. I'll coordinate snapshot access with eng-infra.
Ava: I can own the ML side of telemetry-replay. Ava: ml ETA 2026-04-06. I'll add runbook steps and a sanity-check notebook.
Sam: Great. For the canary playbook — any volunteers? It's SRE-heavy.
Priya: I can help review the rollback playbook once a draft exists but can't lead it this sprint.
Diego: I can help with the rollout checklist (infra bits) but not lead end-to-end.
Sam: Ok, let's assign lead to eng-sre. @incident-bot please add a placeholder for sre lead and set due 2026-04-02.
incident-bot: Created tracker items for RCX-834: finalize-canary-rollback-playbook (owner: eng-sre TBD, due: 2026-04-02), exp-backoff-fix (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-29), telemetry-infra (owner: Diego, due: 2026-04-05), telemetry-ml (owner: Ava, due: 2026-04-06). Links: https://tracker.internal/RCX-834
Priya: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/456 — includes test and deploy job. I set draft -> will convert once CI green.
Ava: Added runbook notes to docs: https://docs.internal/rcx-834/replay-runbook
Sam: Thanks all. Quick process ask: if anyone needs to shift a due date, post here + update tracker with reason. I'll mark these confirmed in 6 hours if no objections. :clock6:
Ava: Confirmed from my side. :white_check_mark:
Diego: Confirmed. :thumbsup:
Priya: Confirmed. Will ping when PR converted.
Sam: Closing loop later today unless something changes. Appreciate the quick responses.
